name: dev-no-setcommitted
description: the developer-mode commit does not mark the log committed
old: L2 { db: db, snap: Some(db), temp: Row { committed: true, ..t }, pc: Pc::Deps, ..s }
new: L2 { db: db, snap: Some(db), temp: t, pc: Pc::Deps, ..s }

name: no-rollback-on-failure
description: the failure path keeps the open transaction's writes
old:
let rolled = match s.snap { Some(d) => d, None => s.db };
    let t = Row { ok: false, ended: true, ..s.temp };
new:
let rolled = s.db;
    let t = Row { ok: false, ended: true, ..s.temp };

name: finalize-overwrites-committed
old: let t = Row { ok: false, ended: true, ..s.temp };
new: let t = Row { ok: false, ended: true, committed: false, ..s.temp };

name: commit-before-activate
description: a transactional load commits before Activate

name: crash-keeps-open-writes
description: a halt commits the open transaction (premise P2 broken)
old: let rolled = match s.snap { Some(d) => d, None => closed };

name: no-premise-pd-strict
description: drop premise PD for the strict contract

name: l1-without-commit-soundness
description: vacuity: L1 without 'Committed = 0 means nothing kept' must lose the dev-crash witness

name: l1-without-dep-record
description: vacuity: strict L1 without the dependency record rule must lose the dependency witness
old: pub open spec fn honest_end_strict(a: L1) -> bool { honest_end(a) && (a.dep_began ==> a.dep.exists) }
new: pub open spec fn honest_end_strict(a: L1) -> bool { honest_end(a) }
